text:
Donald Trump is casting a Democratic takeover of Congress as a threat of national catastrophe, while promising $5,000 checks to American adults if Republicans retain control.
Trump has long portrayed Democrats as an existential threat to the country. As he campaigns to preserve Republican control of Washington, he is warning of burning cities, economic collapse, harm to children and the destruction of Western civilization. Even if Democrats win control of Congress, Trump will remain president and retain veto power over legislation they pass.
This is reported by Axios.
He is also offering voters a financial incentive: $5,000 checks for every adult American citizen if Republicans keep control of Congress. The proposal would cost more than $1 trillion, and there is no clear path to making it happen.
White House spokesman Davis Ingle told Axios in a statement:
President Trump is the unequivocal leader, best messenger, and unmatched motivator for the Republican Party, and he is committed to maintaining Republican majorities in Congress.
 – Davis Ingle
The choice has never been more clear: doubling down on President Trump’s winning, commonsense agenda or the Democrats’ extreme liberal policies and obstruction.
 – Davis Ingle
Trump says America will burn like France
On Monday night, Trump told voters in Kansas that the U.S. would burn like France under Democratic rule. France has faced widespread protests by students and unions over public spending cuts and deficit concerns.
When you see burning steeples and raging fires in France, just remember that is what the radical Dumocrats want to do to America.
 – Donald Trump
Trump has blamed unrest in France on immigration and suggested that Democratic border policies would bring similar chaos to the U.S. But the unrest has been driven by disputes over living costs and public funding. There is no evidence that U.S. Democrats want to pursue similar violence.
Trump predicts another Great Depression
Trump says Democrats would cause an economic catastrophe and trigger a depression like the one that began in 1929. Speaking to voters in Tennessee on Saturday, he said:
If the Democrats win you will have a 1929-style economic depression. I hope I’m wrong on that.
 – Donald Trump
Unemployment peaked at roughly 25% during the Great Depression, compared with about 4% today. If Democrats gain control of the House, they plan to repeal Trump’s tariff policy, restore Affordable Care Act tax breaks and reverse Medicaid cuts as part of a broader affordability push.
Trump says Democrats will “mutilate your children”
In Arizona last week, Trump warned that Democrats wanted to “mutilate, cut your children.” He said:
I mean, they can do whatever they want, and they do. Your son leaves as Jimmy and comes back home in three days as Janet, and they don’t even ask you,
 – Donald Trump
They can take your child out of school and do whatever the hell they want.
 – Donald Trump
Trump’s claims about schools secretly performing gender-transition procedures misrepresent how such medical care works. Schools cannot perform gender-transition surgeries; those operations take place in medical settings under relevant state laws.
Trump says Democrats would “get rid of the border”
Trump has warned that Democrats would dismantle the border and let criminals from around the world enter the U.S. Speaking to voters in Kansas, he said:
the Dumocrat agenda is a plan to extinguish Western civilization. They want to open the borders.
 – Donald Trump
He also claimed that prisons around the world would empty their prisoners into the United States. A coalition of Democrats has proposed using advanced technology to secure the border while rejecting mass deportation strategies.
Trump warns Democrats will take guns
Trump has warned that Democrats would “take away your guns” if they control Congress. Speaking to voters in Montana, he added:
You know who would love that to happen? Some of the wild animals you have up here that like eating you,
 – Donald Trump
… They would gain a lot of weight.
 – Donald Trump
Mainstream Democrats have not called for repealing the Second Amendment. While some support banning certain types of guns, that is different from eliminating the constitutional right to own firearms.
Trump says Democrats would damage farms
Trump has also warned that Democrats would “decimate Kansas farms.” On Monday, his administration announced $8 billion in relief for farmers facing soaring fuel costs. Those costs have been driven in part by Trump’s policies and the Iran war.
Democrats have been appealing to rural voters in Kansas and Iowa. House Democrats have also proposed expanding support for rural development and family farms.
